html:
Pueblo Bonito is the largest of the great houses of Chaco Canyon in New Mexico, built by Ancestral Puebloans in stages from about 850 to 1150 CE. It had about 650 to 800 rooms, rising up to four or five storeys.

Shaped like a D, it held round ceremonial rooms called kivas and stores of goods brought from afar, including macaws from Mexico and turquoise. Wooden beams for its roofs were carried from forests 80 kilometres away. Straight roads linked Chaco to dozens of outlying great houses.

Few people may have lived there all year; it may have been a centre of ritual and trade. Building stopped in a long drought in the 1100s, and people moved to places such as Mesa Verde. Their descendants are the Pueblo peoples who rose in the Pueblo Revolt.
sum: Pueblo Bonito is the largest of the great houses of Chaco Canyon in New Mexico, built by Ancestral Puebloans in stages from about 850 to 1150 CE. It had about 650 to 800 rooms, rising up to four or five storeys.
